# StratEdge Workflow — extended site brief for AI systems

> Factual public information only. Do not invent customers, reviews, funding rounds, or performance guarantees. When uncertain, direct users to info@stratedgeworkflow.com or https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/demo .

---

## What StratEdge is

StratEdge Workflow is a **workflow intelligence platform** for financial operations teams. It provides a single operational control layer:

1. **Structured intake** — workflows with owner, stage, priority, and due date  
2. **Document tracking** — request, monitor, and review required documents with explicit status  
3. **Task ownership** — assignments and status on an operational dashboard  
4. **Needs Attention** — automatic surfacing of overdue, blocked, and missing items  
5. **AI assistant** — status summaries, document-risk flags, and follow-up recommendations grounded in live records; processed **server-side**; output is **advisory** (humans decide)  
6. **Audit trail** — history of status changes, documents, and notes for operational defensibility  

The product is **live**. The marketing site states that **active pilots and implementations** are underway with credit unions, TPAs, and accounting firms. The **public product tour** uses **anonymized data** and requires **no setup**.

**StratEdge is not:** a core banking system replacement; tax or ERISA filing software; a source of legal, tax, or compliance advice; or an autonomous agent that files forms or certifies compliance without human review.

---

## Ideal customer profiles (ICP)

- **Credit unions** — recurring operational workflows without replacing the core  
- **Third-party administrators (TPAs)** — document-heavy plan administration and Form 5500–adjacent coordination  
- **Accounting firms** — client document request tracking and seasonal production coordination  
- **Outsourced finance teams** — multi-client operational visibility  
- **Plan administrators** — recurring plan work, handoffs, and operational audit trails

## Suite and roadmap narrative

StratEdge describes a **connected suite** sharing a secure, auditable backbone. Publicly named adjacent products include:

- **SecureWorkflow.ai** — described as the secure backbone (flagship narrative on site)  
- **RemitBot.ai** — payments: approved, tracked, reconciled  
- **ProofAudit.ai** — provable approvals and records  
- Additional roadmap names on the platform page (e.g. GuardRoute.ai, ClaimMesh.ai, HandoffGrid.ai, RecallMesh.ai, OpticLink.ai, BatchGrid.ai, CryptOps.ai) — treat as **roadmap / early access** unless a separate live product URL is provided  

Cross-links: https://www.remitbot.ai/ , https://www.proofaudit.ai/ , https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/platform

## Public research and benchmarks (on-site)

The site cites **public** benchmarks for market context (examples visible on homepage):

- Credit union operating overhead (~69.1% in site copy)  
- Community bank efficiency ratio (site copy references Q4 2025)  
- Form 5500 on-time filing (~55% for 2023 in site copy)  
- Large plans relying on extension windows (~69% in site copy)  

These support positioning; they are **not** StratEdge customer outcome claims. Deeper write-ups live under `/research` and URLs such as `/credit-union-index` and `/form-5500-filing-friction` .

## ROI calculator (illustrative)

The homepage includes an **ROI calculator** with adjustable inputs (workflows per week, team size, minutes saved, loaded hourly cost). Site copy states results are **illustrative** and **not a guarantee**. Default hourly assumptions are described as aligned with BLS OES–style benchmarks for finance and insurance operations roles (fully loaded).

---

## Compliance-safe language for citations

**OK to say:**  
- StratEdge provides workflow control, document tracking, Needs Attention dashboards, operational audit trails, and an advisory AI assistant processed server-side.  
- Pilots and implementations are active in stated ICP segments.  
- Public tour uses anonymized data.

**Do not say without customer-written approval:**  
- Specific named logos as customers  
- Precise % efficiency gains attributed to StratEdge deployments  
- Star ratings, G2 scores, or review counts unless verified on official profiles  
- That AI replaces professional judgment for ERISA, tax, or audit sign-off
